$comment: Per-source access rules for the internship search. 'permitted' needs evidence; anything unclear is 'unknown', which means no automated extraction. robots.txt rules and a 403 to an identified bot are technical restrictions and are respected. This records what was read on dateChecked; it is not legal advice, so re-check before relying on it.

values.publicLeads: true only where the terms read had no clause on reproducing or reusing listings: the board may then show a search-engine lead as a link-only row (title and link, labelled not checked). Never for a site whose terms forbid it.

sources.officialApi: Partner APIs only (Talent Solutions), by application; none open to job seekers.
sources.searchEngineDiscovery: likely (public job pages; not verified per domain)
sources.evidence: LinkedIn User Agreement (effective 3 November 2025), 8.2: do not "Develop, support or use software, devices, scripts, robots or any other means or processes" to scrape or copy the Services; do not "Copy, use, display or distribute any information (including content) obtained from the Services"; do not "Use bots or other unauthorized automated methods to access the Services".
sources.technicalRestrictions: Logged-out job pages are rate-limited; login walls.
sources.recommendedAccessMethod: Search-engine discovery only (Parallel/Exa result links), then open and apply by hand. Do not fetch, scrape or extract pages automatically, and do not republish listings.
sources.publicLeadsReason: Automated reading or reproduction is prohibited (see evidence).
